cloudDownload.title: Cloud drive download
cloudDownload.description: Recognize Baidu Netdisk, Google Drive and GoFile shares, transfer through a workflow and add tasks to the download center. Other sources wait for attention.
cloudDownload.started: Workflow #{{id}} created. Open its details to handle accounts, dependencies and source selection.
cloudDownload.chooseHint: Choose the content to download. Select one mirror within a group. Review ungrouped links individually; they are never all selected automatically.
cloudDownload.workflow.label: Download workflow
cloudDownload.workflow.loadFailed: Unable to load workflows. Please retry.
cloudDownload.account.label: Baidu Netdisk account
cloudDownload.account.selectionHint: Used for Baidu transfers and downloads. Other providers ignore this setting. Manage credentials in third-party settings.
cloudDownload.account.loadFailed: Unable to load accounts. Check third-party settings and retry.
cloudDownload.account.description: Manage BaiduPCS-Go accounts. Import Baidu credentials to validate login. Credentials stay on the server; logging out clears the local credentials.
cloudDownload.account.name: Account name
cloudDownload.account.stoken: Share transfers require the Netdisk STOKEN. Provide it together with BDUSS.
cloudDownload.allowUngrouped: Automatically select ungrouped sources (enable only when each URL is separate content)
cloudDownload.resume.description: Select sources and provide any missing account, dependency or directory, then continue. Each content target uses one mirror.
cloudDownload.resume.keepDirectory: Leave empty to keep the workflow’s existing directory.
cloudDownload.trigger.name: Download sources submitted
cloudDownload.trigger.description: Starts when sources are submitted from the download center or saved post results. Input includes content groups, candidate URLs, access codes and output directory. Finishing post parsing does not invoke this entry automatically.
cloudDownload.activity.download.prepareS: Build a source workset from post results, keeping content groups and extraction information.
cloudDownload.activity.download.selectSo: Select a source for each content target. Automatic selection uses provider priority and can explicitly include ungrouped sources.
cloudDownload.activity.baidu.transfer.de: Transfer selected Baidu shares into the account and persist remote receipts for later downloads.
cloudDownload.activity.baidu.download.de: Create download-center tasks for remote entries or transfer receipts. Shares need a preceding transfer step.
cloudDownload.activity.download.enqueueS: Route selected sources to download-center tasks. Baidu shares require a preceding transfer. Unsupported sources or missing configuration wait for attention.
cloudDownload.activity.download.awaitCom: Wait for associated tasks and retain downloaded files for each content target. Failed tasks can be fixed before continuing.
cloudDownload.recipe.name: Download selected sources
workflow.activity.cloudPrepare.descripti: Build a source workset from post results, keeping content groups and extraction information.
workflow.activity.cloudSelect.descriptio: Select a source for each content target. Automatic selection uses provider priority and can explicitly include ungrouped sources.
workflow.activity.baiduTransfer.descript: Transfer selected Baidu shares into the account and persist remote receipts for later downloads.
workflow.activity.baiduDownload.descript: Create download-center tasks for remote entries or transfer receipts. Shares need a preceding transfer step.
workflow.activity.cloudEnqueue.descripti: Route selected sources to download-center tasks. Baidu shares require a preceding transfer. Unsupported sources or missing configuration wait for attention.
workflow.activity.cloudAwait.description: Wait for associated tasks and retain downloaded files for each content target. Failed tasks can be fixed before continuing.
cloudDownload.account.cookieHint: Use the Cookie from the Baidu Netdisk website; both BDUSS and STOKEN are required.
workflow.waitReason.cloud.cloudAttention: Resolve an account, dependency or failed task
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_LOGIN_REQUIR: Select and log in to a Baidu account.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_CREDENTIALS_: Invalid Baidu credentials. Import them again.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_SESSION_EXPI: The Baidu session expired. Log in again.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_ACCOUNT_NOT_: The account was deleted. Select another account.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_ACCOUNT_MISM: This operation is bound to another Baidu account. Continue with the original account.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_ACCOUNT_IDEN: These credentials belong to another Baidu identity. Add a separate account.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_TRANSFER_REQ: Transfer the share with the Baidu transfer node first.
cloudDownload.problem.BAIDU_BRIDGE_START: Unable to start the Baidu tool. Check its installation.
cloudDownload.validation.directory: Set an absolute local download directory.
cloudDownload.http: Direct file URL (confirm that this URL returns a file)
